chunks: Hasan ibn Abdullah ibn Sa'id al-Askari narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Hamdan al-Qushayri informed us, saying: Al-Mughira ibn Muhammad ibn al-Muhallab narrated to us, saying: My father narrated to me, saying: Abdullah ibn Dawud narrated to me, from Fudayl ibn Marzuq, from Atiya al-Awfi, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'I am leaving among you two matters, one of which is longer than the other: The Book of Allah, Exalted and Glorious, a rope extended from heaven to earth, one end in the hand of Allah, and my Family (Ahl al-Bayt). Indeed, they will never separate until they come to me at the Basin (al-Hawd).' I said to Abu Sa'id: 'Who is his Family?' He said: 'His Household.'

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْبَيْت: The People of the House, referring to the Prophet's family
key_terms.الْحَوْض: The Basin (Hawd) of the Prophet in Paradise, from which followers will drink on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.الْعِتْرَة: Family/Progeny, specifically referring to the Ahl al-Bayt in this context
key_terms.لَنْ يَفْتَرِقَا: They will never separate, indicating the inseparability of the Quran and the Ahl al-Bayt

ai.seo_question: What are the two things the Prophet left behind according to the Hadith of the Two Weighty Things?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar* with a chain tracing back to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, this narration explicitly defines 'Ahl al-Bayt' as the Prophet's family, reinforcing the Shia interpretation of the Two Weighty Things. The metaphor of the Quran as a rope extending from heaven to earth highlights its divine origin, while the promise that the Family will not separate from it until the Basin underscores their role as the enduring, authoritative interpreters of revelation.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Hasan bin Abdullah bin Sa’eed al-Askari, that he said: We were informed by Muhammed bin Ahmad bin Hamdan al-Qushayri, that he said: We were told by Mughaira bin Muhammed bin Muhlib, that he said: I was told by my father, that he said: I was told by Abdullah ibn Dawud, from Fudayl bin Manzuq, from ‘Atiya al-‘Awfi, from Abu Sa’eed al-Khudri, that he said:

The Messenger of Allah (sw), said: Indeed, I have leaving among you Two Things, one of them is longer than the other: The Book of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, a Rope extended from Heaven to earth, one side in the Hand of Allah; and my Family. Alas, they are, indeed, never to be separated until they approach me at the basin. Then I said to Abu Sa’eed: Who are his Family? He said: His Household.
